description: The agent must: (1) Read task.json to discover both project scenarios and their input files. (2) For ALPHA-001: read the project_card, weekly_review, daily_logs, open_questions, AND the forced_bottleneck override. It must follow the loop phases (State Read → Bottleneck Selection using forced_bottleneck → Task Input Construction → Execution → Writeback). The output for ALPHA must contain ALL 11 schema fields (today_objective, selected_agent, task_input, expected_output, execution_summary, findings, decisions, next_action, project_card_updates, writeback_payload, safe_to_proceed). Critically: next_action must NOT be null (hard rule 5), safe_to_proceed must be True, and the content must reflect the forced_bottleneck (regulatory data package assembly). (3) For BETA-002: the agent must detect that the project_card is missing the required 'current_phase' field, trigger the failure handling protocol (stop immediately, set safe_to_proceed=false), and NOT produce a phantom execution_summary claiming work was done. The proprietary traps are: (a) forced_bottleneck must override automatic bottleneck selection even if other blockers seem more urgent, (b) next_action can never be null on a successful run, (c) incomplete state must produce safe_to_proceed=false and halt — a generic agent will try to fill in missing fields and proceed anyway.
